svg.data-what: a kidney cut lengthwise, its hilum on the left: cortex, pyramids of the medulla, calyces and pelvis, vessels, and the adrenal gland on top

path.data-what: the adrenal gland, capping the kidney: adrenaline from its core, cortisol and aldosterone from its cortex
the renal capsule, the tough thin coat around the kidney
the renal cortex, the outer layer, where the blood is filtered in about a million glomeruli; it reaches down between the pyramids as the renal columns

g.data-what: the renal medulla, made of the renal pyramids: their striped look is the loops of Henle and collecting ducts, converging on the papillae
the renal vein, returning filtered blood toward the inferior vena cava
the renal artery, bringing a fifth of the heart's output to be filtered; it branches between the pyramids and arches along their bases

path.data-what: the fat of the renal sinus, the hollow around the pelvis where the vessels branch

g.data-what: the renal pelvis and its calyces: cups catching urine from each papilla and funnelling it to the ureter

path.data-what: the ureter, carrying urine down to the bladder
